title: DECISION: iterative DP glob for LIST ReDoS prevention
description: IMAP LIST wildcards (* and %) are supplied by the client and are attacker-controlled. A recursive backtracking matcher has worst-case exponential time on adversarial inputs such as repeated percent signs against a long non-matching string, which could block a session for seconds on a single LIST command. The implementation in mailbox.rs uses an iterative O(m*n) DP approach with two rolling boolean rows, keeping space O(n). A combined-length cap of 1 KiB in glob_match rejects pathologically long patterns before any DP work begins. A decision comment in glob_bytes explicitly prohibits replacing this with a recursive implementation or removing the cap. A dedicated timing test verifies the adversarial case completes in under 100ms.
